geometric_block.unit_circle: P_M is nonzero on |z|=1 and has winding one

nonpromotion.completion: A complete contracted prime-power chain can have projected first-jet winding -2 although the complex coefficient block is zero-free with winding one
nonpromotion.composition: The sum of individually winding-one blocks can have winding three

phase_derivative.consequence: mu_M(a)>0 implies strict phase increase by 2*pi and exactly one upward crossing for every constant external phase

route.open_handoff: Derive a C1 heat-and-correction perturbation bound for the positive-margin long families. Do not sum blockwise winding bounds: insert the long/short decomposition into mathsf_X*(L*D_j mathcal_C_N-mathcal_C_N), preserving external phases and the recurrent endpoint.
route.rejoin: Rejoin all p-free bases, singleton chains, the recurrent endpoint, and cutoff homotopies before estimating the ray defect or successor winding
route.short_blocks: Keep p=2 lengths 2..7 and p=3 lengths 2..3 inside an explicit finite block ledger; M=1 is exact

short_chain_guard.counts: two upward and two downward crossings on [0,2*pi)

thresholds.large_primes: p>=5: M=1 is exact and M>=2 has mu_M>=mu_2(5^(-1/2))=(3-sqrt(5))/4>0

proof_boundary: This artifact proves the correction-free geometric block phase formula, elementary monotonicity margin, uniform one-turn families p>=5, p=3 with M>=4, and p=2 with M>=8, and an exact complete two-level recrossing guard for p=2,3. It does not prove C1 stability under the heat quadratic or d_n corrections, a joined p-free or endpoint theorem, the Xi Abel gap, H_j<3*pi/2, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

rows.claim: Isolate one complete geometric prime-power block.
rows.proof_boundary: This is the t=0 correction-free internal chain model.

rows.claim: The finite block has one rational geometric representation.
rows.proof_boundary: Both denominator and numerator are nonzero on |z|=1.

rows.claim: Every geometric block is unit-circle nonzero with winding one.
rows.proof_boundary: Winding one does not imply monotone phase or one upward crossing.

rows.claim: Differentiate the two geometric factors without an argument branch.
rows.proof_boundary: K_m is the angular current of 1-r*exp(i*m*theta).

rows.claim: The block phase speed is an explicit difference of two kernels.
rows.proof_boundary: The external constant phase does not change this derivative.

rows.claim: Each geometric-factor current has sharp elementary bounds.
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoint values cos(m*theta)=1 and -1 attain the bounds.

rows.claim: A positive scalar margin forces strict one-turn phase.
rows.proof_boundary: The bound is sufficient and may be negative for a monotone block.

rows.claim: When mu_M(a)>0, every constant-phase real projection has one upcrossing.
rows.formula: For all alpha, Re(exp(i*alpha)P_M(e^(i*theta))) has two simple zeros and one upward zero on [0,2*pi).
rows.proof_boundary: This is internal to one geometric block.

rows.claim: The tail penalty decreases once a is below M/(M+1).
rows.proof_boundary: This propagates one checked base margin to all longer blocks.

rows.claim: Every correction-free p>=5 block has strict phase monotonicity.
rows.proof_boundary: Heat and d_n perturbations are not included.

rows.claim: Every correction-free ternary block of length at least four is monotone.
rows.proof_boundary: Lengths two and three are outside this theorem.

rows.claim: Every correction-free dyadic block of length at least eight is monotone.
rows.proof_boundary: Lengths two through seven are outside this theorem.

rows.claim: A complete two-level chain can still have four simple crossings.
rows.proof_boundary: This applies to p=2 and p=3; it is not an Xi phase-attainment claim.

rows.claim: The complete short-chain guard has two upward crossings.
rows.proof_boundary: The coefficient block itself remains nonzero and winds one.

rows.claim: Multiplicative completion alone does not imply first-jet one-turn behavior.
rows.formula: block winding=1 but projected first-jet winding=-2 in the guard.
rows.proof_boundary: External phase and phase speed must be controlled quantitatively.

rows.claim: Use the positive long-block margin as a C1 perturbation budget.
rows.proof_boundary: The heat quadratic, d_n phases, and moving base phase must be retained.

rows.claim: Even monotone one-turn blocks can produce a multi-turn sum.
rows.formula: The existing exact two-block model sums two winding-one blocks to winding three.
rows.proof_boundary: P-free blocks and the recurrent endpoint must be rejoined first.

rows.claim: Split future chain analysis into robust long blocks and explicit short blocks.
rows.formula: Prove C1 stability on the monotone families; keep short p=2,3 blocks, singleton chains, p-free phases, cutoffs, and endpoint inside the joined ray defect.
rows.proof_boundary: No joined Abel gap or successor winding bound is proved.
